channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Sir Alex Ferguson admits terror before emotional 2018 Old Trafford comeback
item.description: Sir Alex Ferguson returned to Old Trafford less than four months after emergency brain surgery in 2018, fearing he would not receive a warm welcome.

item.title: Digital tickets for MTN8 final surge onto OpenTickets platform this Friday
item.description: Fans can purchase up to four digital tickets starting Friday at 10:00 for the MTN8 final between Orlando Pirates and Mamelodi Sundowns.

item.title: Andrew Garfield Recalls Robert Redford Arriving Four Hours Late To Film Set
item.description: Actor Andrew Garfield revealed that the late Hollywood icon Robert Redford was habitually four hours late while filming the 2007 drama Lions for Lambs.

item.title: Amazon Unleashes Kindle Colorsoft With Seamless Edge-to-Edge Color Across New Lineup
item.description: Amazon introduced the new Kindle Colorsoft and redesigned e-reader lineup on October 1, with shipping scheduled for late October.

item.title: ChatGPT Virtual Try-On Feature Transforms Selfies Into Digital Fitting Room Sessions
item.description: OpenAI launched global shopping features for ChatGPT that allow users to virtually try on clothing and save favorite items to a library.

item.title: Chery snatches local crown as new bakkie becomes the official Grootman
item.description: Following a national voting campaign, Chery South Africa has officially named its upcoming double-cab hybrid bakkie the Grootman for its 2027 market debut.

item.title: SASSA Confirms October Grant Dates While November Schedule Faces Election Review
item.description: The South African Social Security Agency has set its October 2026 payment schedule while reviewing November dates due to local elections.

item.title: WhatsApp Unlocks New Parental Controls Locked Behind A Mandatory Parent PIN
item.description: Meta introduced optional parental controls for WhatsApp, allowing guardians to manage teen account settings and monitor group activity via a secure PIN.

item.title: €8.5 Billion Budget 2027 Looms As Irish Households Struggle With Daily Costs
item.description: The government is set to announce an €8.5 billion budget package on October 6, targeting tax relief amid rising fuel and food prices.

item.title: Trump Says Canada Being Taught A Little Lesson In Escalating Trade War
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has imposed new tariffs on Canadian goods, leading to an impasse in trade negotiations between the two countries.

item.title: 1,949 Arrested as Violent Student Protests Ignite French Schools Nationwide
item.description: Massive student demonstrations against school conditions and funding led to 1,949 arrests and 305 police injuries on Thursday.

item.title: French Open Champion Mirra Andreeva Faces Yue Yuan in Beijing Clash
item.description: Mirra Andreeva is set to play Yue Yuan in the China Open round-of-64 on Friday in Beijing.

item.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 rockets Crew-13 to orbit despite morning weather uncertainty
item.description: Four astronauts successfully launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Florida's Space Coast to the International Space Station at 11:10 a.m. ET on Thursday.

item.title: Devon Levi storms the net for first career Edmonton Oilers start
item.description: The 24-year-old goaltender makes his first start for the Oilers against the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday at 10 p.m. ET.

item.title: Mexico and United States clash at State Farm Stadium for 80th meeting
item.description: The United States Men’s National Team hosts rivals Mexico in a friendly match at the 63,400-seat State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Arizona.

item.title: Oilers blast four first-period goals to silence Canucks at Rogers Arena
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers surged to a 4-0 lead in the opening period against the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday.

item.title: Putin Vows To Use Every Available Weapon To Protect Russian Kaliningrad Exclave
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin declared at the Valdai foreign policy forum that Moscow will deploy all weapons at its disposal if Kaliningrad faces a direct attack.

item.title: Malaysia Smashes Singapore 6-0 in Heaviest Defeat Since 1978 Historic Loss
item.description: Singapore was eliminated from the FIFA ASEAN Cup on October 1 after suffering a 6-0 defeat to Malaysia.

item.title: Arsenal Star Christos Tzolis Limps Off During Greece's Draw With Netherlands
item.description: Greece blew a two-goal lead in a 2-2 Nations League draw against the Netherlands as Arsenal's Christos Tzolis exited with an injury in the 18th minute.

item.title: Khaw Boon Wan retires as SPH Media chairman after five years
item.description: Khaw Boon Wan is stepping down from his role as SPH Media chairman, with CEO Chan Yeng Kit taking over as executive chairman.

item.title: Neco Williams strike fuels Wales comeback to topple 10-man Norway
item.description: Wales secured their first Nations League A victory of 2026 by rallying to defeat Norway 2-1 in Cardiff.

item.title: Portugal silences Denmark 4-2 in Copenhagen to maintain perfect group record
item.description: Portugal secured a 4-2 win against Denmark in the UEFA Nations League Group A4 to extend their winning streak.

item.title: Fever Force Decider As Caitlin Clark Masterpiece Stuns Defending Champion Aces
item.description: The Indiana Fever defeated the Las Vegas Aces 99-89 in Game 2, forcing a winner-take-all Game 3 on Thursday.

item.title: Undefeated Florida Panthers invade San Jose for high-stakes second game clash
item.description: The 1-0-0 Florida Panthers continue their California road trip against the San Jose Sharks tonight at 10 p.m. ET.

item.title: Canberra procession honours four fallen officers on National Police Remembrance Day
item.description: Hundreds of officers marched to the National Police Memorial on September 29 to enshrine the names of four fallen personnel.

item.title: Lionel Messi Snaps Up Century Old Spanish Football Club CD Eldense
item.description: Lionel Messi has acquired 100 percent of Spanish Segunda División side CD Eldense to become the club's new majority shareholder.

item.title: Carter Efe Dominates Speed Darlington In Chaos In The Ring Boxing Bout
item.description: Carter Efe secured a technical knockout victory against Speed Darlington at the Chaos in the Ring event held on October 1, 2026.

item.title: 17 crew airlifted to safety after fishing boat strikes Orkney rocks
item.description: The Genesis fishing vessel ran aground off the island of Hoy on October 1, prompting a major multi-agency rescue operation.

item.title: Igor Shesterkin makes history as first Rangers goalie to score a goal
item.description: Igor Shesterkin became the 18th goaltender in NHL history to record a goal, sealing a 5-1 win over the Tampa Bay Lightning on Thursday.

item.title: Steelers and Browns Collide Thursday With AFC North Lead on the Line
item.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers face the Cleveland Browns this Thursday, October 1, in a pivotal AFC North division clash.

item.title: Barkov exits in second game back after awkward fall against Sharks
item.description: Panthers captain Aleksander Barkov left Thursday's game against San Jose in the second period following a fall, just days into his return from a torn ACL and MCL that sidelined him all of last season.

item.title: Portugal Snatches 4-2 Victory Over Denmark In Life After Cristiano Ronaldo
item.description: Portugal maintained their perfect Nations League start by defeating Denmark 4-2 in Copenhagen as Vitinha and Joao Felix secured late goals.

item.title: Kenya seeks redemption in Guinea after Eritrea stalemate
item.description: Kenya's national team faces Guinea on Thursday at 7 pm in Conakry, looking to recover from a 1-1 draw with Eritrea in their Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaign.

item.title: Minimum wage surges in 5 provinces as pay rates climb nationwide
item.description: Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, Manitoba and Saskatchewan hiked minimum hourly wages on October 1, 2026.

item.title: Emirates Airbus A380 diverts to Frankfurt after mid-air passenger medical emergency
item.description: Emirates flight EK31 from Dubai to London Heathrow made an emergency landing at Frankfurt Airport on Thursday after a passenger required medical attention.

item.title: Swift Telephone Network clinches licence to challenge Nigeria's telecom market giants
item.description: Swift Telephone Network Limited has secured a Unified Access Service Licence from the Nigerian Communications Commission to provide nationwide telecommunications services.

item.title: Public Protector finds Mashazi guilty of improper conduct over unqualified appointment
item.description: Former Ekurhuleni City Manager Imogen Mashazi was found guilty of improper conduct by Public Protector Kholeka Gcaleka on Thursday for appointing Ndumiso Gcwabe to a senior metro police role despite him lacking the required NQF level 7 qualification.

item.title: KFC jumps 30% bigger on chicken tenders after complaints of dry, scrawny rivals
item.description: KFC relaunched larger, crispier chicken tenders this week after a surge in complaints and lost sales to competitors, marking the first step in its biggest menu overhaul in decades.

item.title: Watson's 2-win streak ends reevaluation talk at Cleveland after 2-1 start
item.description: Deshaun Watson has led the Cleveland Browns to back-to-back victories following an opening loss, shifting the team's short-term plans away from week-to-week quarterback changes.

item.title: Crew-13 blasts off from Florida to reach the International Space Station
item.description: Four astronauts successfully launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Kennedy Space Center at 11:10 a.m. Thursday.
